description: Full CMS Care Compare ratings for one hospital (by facility id, or name with state or city): overall star rating with the reason when unrated; how many mortality, safety and readmission measures are better, no different or worse than the national rate; HCAHPS patient survey stars overall and by topic (nurses, doctors, cleanliness, quiet, discharge), share rating it 9 or 10 and who would recommend it against national; ER median time from arrival to leaving, left without being seen, sepsis care and staff flu vaccination, each against the state and national average.

facility_id.description: CMS facility id (CCN), 6 characters such as 220071. Best when known (hospital_search returns it).

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, such as "Mass General" or "Brigham and Women's".

state.description: State code or name. Narrows a name lookup.

name: hospital_ratings
title: Hospital star rating and quality detail
